summary: Proposed LEARN-02.1 source baseline: eight rule-scored pre-dispatch dimensions and safety-preserving model-tier/effort profiles. Unknown dimensions route best/high; source and delta review does not dispatch another actor. The offline-first recording helper binds a native Delivery comment to an existing learn-task-snapshot telemetry fact by digest; explicit record mode uses the admitted workspace receiver and retains partial-effect intent. No live recording or policy adoption is established. Retrospective anchors are seven PR examples from six Deliveries, with 19 explicitly recorded rounds; two Algorithms PRs share one Delivery. A broader read-only attributed-store census yields 32 eligible Project 3 Deliveries; partial log-token association is weak and differs from the four anchor overlaps. Complete blocking counts, whole-Delivery usage, causal effects and prospective overlap remain unknown. Retain the fixed proposal; a future bounded contextual bandit and off-policy evaluation require reviewed source, valid propensities and effect-specific admission. This framework record indexes the owning design; private raw evidence is excluded.
title: LEARN-02 versioned hardness baseline and dispatch observation
